caption: The drawing depicts a circular object, possibly a plate or shield, with a central motif of a stylized, two-headed bird. The bird’s necks curve outward, and each head faces opposite directions. The bodies of the bird are joined and extend downward into a single, vase-like form. Both wings are outstretched, decorated with multiple, evenly spaced feather-like lines. The color palette consists of muted earth tones, primarily light browns, greens, and muted reds or purples. Surrounding the bird, on both sides at the bottom, are leafy branches extending sideways. The perimeter of the drawing is bordered by a wavy band of reddish-brown color, and the background is a pale beige or tan color. The illustration is signed in the lower right corner with the name "M. Saltzman."
title: Pa. German Dish
